text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Due to construction at Nakayama Racecourse, this year's Satsuki Sho will be held in Tokyo, like the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The first Classic race, the Satsuki Sho, is about to begin here in Tokyo…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaeno's apparently been training super hard. She's probably in her best condition right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Inhale… exhale…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's no good. I tried to convince myself not to be nervous, but it's not working.
choice_data_list: It's natural to be nervous about racing a rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I guess you're right. Phew…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to win. I don't want to lose to my rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to win. That's why I've been pushing myself so hard.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to win! So I can get closer to my dream than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I will! Be back soon!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (The racecourse is totally packed. The crowd's crammed in like sardines.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This is a Classic race—a race that you can only ever compete in once…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I haven't started running yet, but my body already feels hot.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaeno…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You were always running ahead of me on the racer's path, your eyes burning with intensity.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's why I dedicated myself to training, determined to best what I saw in you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I worked toward this once-in-a-lifetime stage, concentrating down my every desire and dream, all so I could overcome the hill before me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I have honed myself to a perfect edge. And now, I will repay the gratitude I owe my master.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Even so, I won't let you have this—no matter how tough you might be.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And if you consider me a rival… If you're going to try and take my precious goals from me…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Then I'll defeat you today, right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm sure our battle will be over in an instant…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. Our rivalry will be settled here, at the one and only Satsuki Sho we'll ever be able to run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And because of that…

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: I won't lose to you!
